provenance.locator: Curated providerId to sourceRecordId aliases for official Ministry map rows whose names differ from ANMCS names by city suffixes, diacritics, punctuation, abbreviations or patronymic wording.
provenance.note: Aliases are accepted only when the builder can verify that the provider, alias row and official Ministry source row still share the same county and the source row still carries a street address.

limitations.text: This file does not enable general fuzzy matching. Each alias pins one ANMCS provider id to one Ministry source record id and the builder rejects county mismatches, missing source rows, reused source records and source rows without street-address evidence.

Aliases attach official address and coordinate evidence only. They do not rewrite the health mart's UAT placement; downstream road-proxy routing still has to declare how provider points are snapped to the road graph.
